source.title: Probing the catalytic functions of Bub1 kinase using the small molecule inhibitors BAY-320 and BAY-524
source.notice_scope: Fresh official Europe PMC core metadata contains no commentCorrectionList or retracted-publication label; bounded metadata observation, not integrity clearance.

conclusion: Retain genuine drug-treated antiproliferative combination findings, with formal BAY-320 synergy distinct from BAY-524 potentiation. Neither is BUBR1 restoration or improved fidelity. RPE1 relative sparing is restricted by dose and endpoint;4nM paclitaxel combinations produce essentially all severe errors in the plotted RPE1 cells. No drug-treated animal efficacy/PK/tolerability or MVA evidence.

models.HeLa: Aneuploid HeLa S3 and H2B-GFP variants; HeLa Kyoto FRET assays.
models.RPE1: hTERT-immortalized near-diploid cells, H2B-GFP and endogenous tagged-protein variants; not primary normal muscle or constitutional MVA.
models.other: NCI-H1299 formal BAY-320 synergy; A375 only supplementary proliferation values; HEK293T for LAP-Bub1 purification and Hi5 insect cells for recombinant catalytic domain.
models.controls: DMSO vehicle, siGl2 versus siBub1, WT versus K821R KD Bub1, AuroraB/Mps1/Haspin probe comparisons and Haspin-substrate control.

IC50_TR_FRET.construct: His6 human BUB1 residues704–1085 expressed in Hi5 cells
IC50_TR_FRET.source: Methods Determination of IC50-concentrations; Supplementary file1 rows1–4

Figure1B.construct: WT or K821R KD LAP-Bub1 expressed/purified from mitotic HEK293T cells
Figure1B.limit: Separate qualitative dose-response/control assay; not the source of680/450nM IC50s.

cellular_target_readout.conditions: HeLa nocodazole16h then BAY3201h, in-cell western normalized to cell stain

supplement1_proliferation_IC50_uM.limits: Native table gives molar units and SD columns only for kinase and HeLa; A375 no SD, table assay duration/n not specified.

functional_findings.single_agent: Modest timing effects and no significant live missegregation elevation in tested conditions, despite persistent chromosome-arm cohesion and Sgo/CPC redistribution. HeLa protein depletion causes much larger timing/congression/checkpoint defects.
functional_findings.monastrol_release: 150μM monastrol challenge then washout into MG132+inhibitor2h: >90% drug-treated HeLa aligned; about28% Bub1-depleted cells failed full alignment. n170–200 cells. Alignment under arrest is not productive-lineage rescue.

colony_assay.readout: Cresyl Violet stained population intensity after methanol fixation
colony_assay.result: Combination reduced HeLa signal more strongly than RPE1, but RPE1 also declined; not a general safety window.

formal_synergy.readout: CellTiter-Glo normalized to DMSO and pretreatment readings
formal_synergy.native_figure_limit: HeLa Z10 approximately0.89 visually exceeds0.8. Do not claim allratios or BAY524/RPE1 formally synergistic. Numeric rawCI values were not recovered.

segregation.low_dose_result: Much greater severe-error enhancement in HeLa than RPE1
segregation.paclitaxel_4nM_result: Native RPE1 BAY-combination bars essentially all severe defects; paclitaxel alone already substantial. Visual categorical bar interpretation, no raw-cell recount.

nocodazole_challenge.scope: Separate challenged assay,150cells per condition from3experiments; no extrapolation to general normal-cell or paclitaxel safety.

BUB1B_connection.endpoint: HeLa kinetochore IF relative intensity, Figure6A–B
BUB1B_connection.result: Localization largely retained with BAY inhibitors; BAY524 lower bar and possible modest effect described, versus marked loss after Bub1 depletion. Not an equivalence test.

BAY320_activity_panel.limit: Single-point assay, not cross-targetIC50; some entries are mouse-labeled. Do not infer exact20-fold margin from this table.

BAY320_binding_panel.limit: Binding competition under stated concentrations, not catalytic activity or full cellular specificity at3–10μM.

selectivity.BAY524: No matching broad panel in this paper; target/phenotypic evidence cannot inherit BAY320 panel coverage.
selectivity.BUB1B_panel_row: No BUB1B/BubR1 entry found in either native panel.
selectivity.cellular_control: BAY inhibitors spare Haspin-dependent H3-T3 phosphorylation at tested exposures;5-iodotubercidin changes it.

animal_evidence.scope: Genetic mouse viability and Mps1 mouse studies are cited background; antibody-production animal work is not BAY efficacy.

other_agents.nocodazole: microtubule challenge/synchronization,typically3.3μM with distinct sorting/purification conditions
other_agents.not_new_efficacy_appraisals: Controls/culture reagents are not automatically new candidates.

limitations: 2–3 independent experiments pooled in microscopy methods; cell/kinetochore counts are not independent mice/patients.
Figure8F categorical bars lack underlying raw-cell counts and experiment-level uncertainties in retrieved files.
Supplementary proliferation assay duration/n and A375 culture details are not clearly supplied.
No demonstrated inhibitor-resistant Bub1 rescue, broad normal-tissue study, in-vivo exposure or therapeutic efficacy.
Figure3 supplement1 image labels BAY-520 whereas caption identifies BAY-524; no invented third compound.
Relative RPE1 sparing and author interpretation do not establish patient safety or a clinically usable drug window.

appraisal_correction.reason: Separate the recombinant-domain synthetic-peptide2mM-ATP IC50 assay from the WT/KD LAP-Bub1-H2A100μM-ATP assay.

proposed_appraisals.route: BAY-320 / Bub1 catalytic inhibition and paclitaxel sensitization
proposed_appraisals.disposition: Retain experimental anticancer-combination comparator and Bub1 probe; do not elect BUBR1-restoration route
proposed_appraisals.rationale: BAY-320 inhibits recombinant BUB1 and cellular H2A-T120 phosphorylation. It enhances paclitaxel-associated loss of colony signal and chromosome missegregation. A separate 96-hour fixed-ratio assay supports formal synergy in HeLa and NCI-H1299, with the HeLa Z10 ratio above the study's CI≤0.8 cutoff. RPE1 is relatively spared at lower paclitaxel concentrations but shows near-universal severe segregation defects in 4 nM combinations. BubR1 kinetochore IF was measured without protein restoration; BUB1 catalytic inhibition is distinct from BUB1B targeting or Bub1 depletion. No drug-treated animal efficacy, PK, normal-tissue window or MVA rescue is established.
proposed_appraisals.evidence_scope: Complete 2016 scientific main/captions, all three native supplementary tables and all eight main figures; selected figure supplements and bounded root panel/assay check.

proposed_appraisals.route: BAY-524 / Bub1 catalytic inhibition and paclitaxel potentiation
proposed_appraisals.disposition: Retain experimental cell-combination comparator; do not inherit BAY-320 formal synergy or broad-panel selectivity
proposed_appraisals.rationale: BAY-524 inhibits recombinant BUB1 and cellular H2A-T120 phosphorylation. At 7–10 µM it enhances seven-day paclitaxel-associated colony reduction and segregation defects; the native potency table reports HeLa proliferation IC50 shifting from 8.1 ± 1.2 µM alone to 0.64 ± 0.59 µM with 3 nM paclitaxel. Formal fixed-ratio synergy and broad kinase panels belong to BAY-320, not this compound. RPE1 combination harm at 4 nM paclitaxel limits normal-cell-sparing claims. BubR1 kinetochore signal is modestly lower, not restored; catalytic inhibition and Bub1 protein depletion have different consequences. No animal therapeutic window, normal-muscle output or MVA efficacy is established.
proposed_appraisals.evidence_scope: Complete 2016 scientific main/captions and native potency table/figures; BAY-320-only panel and formal-synergy limits retained.
